messages:
mikaela: quick sync — we have 2 customer asks that touch SDK + docs: typed TS client for embeddings+rerank, and Python examples for function calling + structured outputs. want to decide gating criteria for next sprint.
lee: +1. can we scope a minimal TS typedefs package (no breaking changes) and 3 python cookbooks? :eyes:
sam: for SDK work: estimate: TS types + tests 3 dev-weeks, python examples + tests 1.5 dev-weeks. need CI infra for e2e examples.
tina: customers asked for explicit launch criteria: 1) types shipped and published, 2) docs examples for chat/embeddings/rerank/function-calling, 3) migration notes & changelog, 4) smoke tests in ci, 5) canary release for 24h. Thoughts?
ben: add quality checks: example-driven evals for structured output (run 20 prompts, compare schema conformance). we can reuse the eval harness.
mikaela: agree with tina + ben. re: prioritization, Customer A (fintech) is blocking on typed TS for embeddings, Customer B (marketplace) needs Python function-calling examples for GDPR review. propose prioritizing TS types + python examples for function-calling first.
lee: ok. follow-up: do we want to expose new typed signatures for rerank embeddings or keep existing loose signature and provide separate helper typings?
sam: prefer helper typings to avoid breaking contracts. shipping as an optional @types package or mono-repo package with clear upgrade path.
tina: launch checklist draft: 
- public: release notes & changelog entry 
- docs: 3 examples (embeddings, rerank, function-calling structured output) 
- SDK: TS types published, python examples in repo, CI smoke tests 
- QA: automated schema conformance for structured outputs, manual spot-checks 
- Rollout: canary + opt-in early access for customer A/B 
Can we commit to this for sprint 42?
lee: sprint 42 might be tight but doable if we deprioritize the broader examples set. need allocation from eng leads.
docs-bot: FYI — existing examples folder: /docs/examples/python/function_calling.py, /docs/examples/ts/embeddings.ts (old shallow examples). recommend migrating and expanding rather than starting from scratch.
ben: also consider quantization/latency notes in examples for Dedicated customers — show perf tradeoffs for heavy rerank workloads.
mikaela: decision call: prioritize TS types + python function-calling examples, helper typings for rerank, include structured-output evals in QA. if eng leads confirm capacity, ship canary end of sprint 42.
sam: I will sync with eng leads today and post capacity numbers.
tina: i'll draft the changelog blurb + migration notes template, share later today.
lee: can we add a small code snippet in docs for structured output guidance? e.g.:
```py
# python structured output example
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model=\"rw-1.2\", messages=[{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Create JSON for order with items and totals\"}], functions=[...])
assert resp.output_schema.matches(schema)
```
small and simple.
docs-bot: will create a docs PR template for example additions and link to the changelog template.
deploy-bot: planned canary window configured: 2026-04-15 02:00-06:00 UTC (tentative) :calendar: 
mikaela: thanks all — next steps: sam to confirm capacity, tina to draft changelog + migration, lee to start typings PR draft, docs-bot to open templates. I'll reconvene Tue 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
